The whole complex closes at 25:29's declaration that Yahweh is calling for a sword against the earth. Whether this cup vision anticipates the later nations material or stands as this sermon's own close is left open here, and the row is held at reduced confidence on that account.
strongest_rejected_alternative: Splitting the row at 25:27, where a fresh frame-command opens, was considered and set aside on command-and-performance grounds: the frame-command continues the same commissioned act already under way, and the row is held together on that continuity rather than on any claim about the command's addressee. The envoys the sign is sent through are said to come יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֶל צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה (oshb:Jer.27.3, byte), matching “to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah” (web:Jer.27.3): the reign named at the header and the reign the delivered sign actually reaches diverge, and that divergence is held open here rather than resolved by reading a different king at the header.
